articles.title: Hamas military wing told donors to avoid sending crypto directly from Binance, DOJ filing shows
articles.snippet: Hamas’ military wing advised donors not to use Binance to handle funds but rather to use Trust Wallet, Bybit, OKX, Kast and Redotpay to send funds to an external TRON wallet, according to recent U.S. Department of Justice documents.

articles.title: Fed meeting is shaping up to be a nightmare for Warsh. Bitcoin might still shine
articles.snippet: An aggressive market expectations trap and a strict aversion to forward guidance have backed the Fed chair into a corner, where failing to deliver a hawkish message risks destroying the central bank’s inflation-fighting credibility.

articles.title: Ethiopia cuts Bitcoin miners’ power by 77% amid hydropower shortage: Report
articles.snippet: Bitcoin miners generated 35% of the state-owned power producer’s revenue last year, but declining reservoir inflows led the utility to prioritize households and manufacturers.

articles.title: Bitcoin ETFs shed $450M in biggest outflow since June
articles.snippet: The $450 million withdrawal came as Bitcoin fell 2.5% and the CLARITY Act failed to advance in the Senate, with Fidelity and BlackRock funds leading the outflows.

articles.title: Zuckerberg Pushes Back on Coordinated AI Slowdown, Says Labs Can Act Alone
articles.snippet: Meta’s CEO says competition and potential liability give AI developers reasons to prioritize safety, citing the company’s decision to delay Muse.
